max_request_media_files.description: Most referenced files one request carries. Absent or null: 20. Past it the oldest are left out, down to half.

max_request_media_mb.description: Most MiB of referenced files one request carries. Absent or null: 20. Past it the oldest are left out, down to half.

compaction_model.description: Model that writes the compaction summary. Absent = the agent's own model. `provider` may name any configured provider; credentials are resolved by that provider id. If it cannot be built, the compaction fails (history kept, compaction_failed logged) — it never falls back to the agent's model.

allow_local_fetch.description: Allow sys_fetch/ws_connect to reach private (RFC1918) and CGNAT destinations. When false/absent those are refused, including after DNS resolution and across redirects. Loopback is allowed either way, except the local daemon control API; link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are always refused.

auto_retry.description: Retry the failed turn automatically after a transient provider error (rate limit, overload, network).

receive.description: Whether the agent participates in the mesh and can receive messages.

browser.description: Run the visible desktop (X server, Openbox, tint2, noVNC, managed Chromium) in the isolated container and show the Computer tab (default true). false = headless-only, no viewer.

name.description: Typed after the slash. 1–32 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; starts with a letter. Not one of: compact, clear, skills, idle, hibernate, stop, off. Unique in commands.

lambda.description: "path/file.ts:functionName". The function receives one object: { command, args, argv, invoker, loop, authorized, id }.

allow_tcp_bind.description: Enables TCP stream binding. Fails closed on its own — every bind is denied until tcp_allowlist has at least one rule.

host.description: Exact hostname/IP, or "*" to match every host.

tcp_allowlist.description: Required whenever allow_tcp_bind is true. A rule with no port constraint allows every port on that host; use { host: "*" } to allow everything explicitly.

allow_wildcard.description: Required to subscribe to "*" or bare "prefix.*" event_types, matching the umbilical_tap gate.

max_rate_per_sec.description: Token-bucket ceiling. Frames beyond it are dropped and counted in binding.flow_summary.frames_dropped.

exclude_source.description: Suppress events whose "source" equals this value, e.g. "lambda:lib/tap.ts:onEvent".

allow_wildcard.description: Required to subscribe to "*" or bare "prefix.*" event_types, matching the umbilical_tap gate.

max_rate_per_sec.description: Token-bucket ceiling. Frames beyond it are dropped and counted in binding.flow_summary.frames_dropped.

exclude_source.description: Suppress events whose "source" equals this value, e.g. "lambda:lib/tap.ts:onEvent".

queue_high_water_bytes.description: Per-direction cap on queued-but-unwritten bytes (default 4194304). At the cap the source is paused and resumes at half; unpausable sources drop frames instead.

drain_timeout_ms.description: How long termination waits for in-flight writes to flush (default 1000).

goal.description: Appended to the loop's instructions. Optional; required (non-empty) when autostart is true.

autostart.description: Run a first turn on the goal at create and whenever the agent starts, instead of waiting to be addressed. Requires a non-empty goal.

autonomous.description: Keep turning after text-only responses until the loop calls sys_set_state. Per-loop; not inherited from the host. Default false.

model.description: Overrides the parent's model for this loop only. Absent = inherit. `provider` may name a different configured provider than the parent's (e.g. a grok-subscription loop under a chatgpt-subscription host); credentials are resolved by that provider id. A loop whose provider cannot be built does not start.

compact_threshold.description: Token count at which this loop auto-compacts its own history. Absent = inherit the parent's `context.compact_threshold`. Exists for the `model` override: a different model has a different context window, so the host trigger point may not suit this loop.

tools.description: Absolute allow-list, intersected with host-enabled tools at derive time. Nothing is implicit — loop_send/loop_list must be listed to be granted.
